independent_case.title: Apply a new case independently
independent_case.task: Partner changes preprocessing and data version while keeping old run ID. What must be preserved?
independent_case.answer: Teacher explanation: Preserve original artifacts/results, assign a new run/version and document changes. Different inputs define a different comparison.
independent_case.source: primary source W4, first curriculum occurrence

misconceptions: The worked result establishes every future case
Reproducibility supports checking the computation, not automatic validity of the research claim.
A missing input may be replaced without recording the change
A replacement changes the evidence or contract. Record the change and its justification; do not silently turn unknown into a measured value.
Repeating an assessed case is new independent evidence
A replay checks consistency. An example used for feedback or revision cannot later be described as untouched final evaluation.

blocks.text: Record exact data IDs/splits, code version, dependency versions, parameters, randomness policy and raw outputs. Verify hashes for integrity without treating them as correctness proofs.
